title: Workspace Chrome Visual Principles
principles: Navigation should look like navigation, not content.
The map remains the dominant visual surface.
One active tool gets one obvious title.
Metadata should be grouped before adding another container.
Typography and spacing should establish hierarchy before borders.
Status should be legible without demanding attention.
Scientific safety language stays visible where necessary.
Internal provenance should not dominate normal operation.

implementationRules.chooser: Rows use names and only state/reason when useful; tool descriptions remain in the drawer.
implementationRules.borders: Strong borders remain on controls and floating surfaces; metadata uses alignment and typography; no per-row cards.
implementationRules.activeStates: Stage selection remains the strongest navigation state; current tool gets a restrained fill plus a Current label; disclosures stay structural.
implementationRules.status: Keep status text and semantic dot; do not rely on color alone.
implementationRules.map: Preserve existing map toolbar and legend DOM/semantics; correct chooser position and compact the map-plan prompt only.
